visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short black hair and rectangular glasses, wearing a black button-up shirt, stands in a studio setting. He gestures expressively with both hands while speaking to the camera. The background is a large, out-of-focus image of a textured, golden-brown snack like fried chicken. The lighting is bright and professional, casting even light on his face. (2) The scene transitions to a high-quality CGI animation of Earth viewed from space. Thousands of small white dots, representing satellites, are seen orbiting the planet in a dense, chaotic swarm. The background is the dark void of space with stars in the distance. A label identifying a research paper appears in small text near the top. (3) The man returns to the screen, holding a small black object resembling a remote or pen in his right hand. He uses it to accentuate his points, moving his hands in circles and wide arcs. The setting remains the indoor studio with the fried chicken graphic, and the overall color tone is warm and vibrant. (4) A scientific slide is overlaid on the screen, showing two complex line graphs comparing orbital object density at different altitudes. The charts use various colors like purple, green, and blue to categorize different types of debris and payloads. The text labels are clear and technical. (5) The man is shown again, continuing his energetic presentation. He leans slightly forward toward the camera to emphasize the gravity of the situation. His facial expressions are highly active, matching the informative and slightly urgent nature of his speech. The background and lighting remain consistent. (6) A data table is presented on screen, displaying a comparison of collision risks and 'CRASH Clock' timings for the years 2018 and 2025. The table is neatly formatted with black text on a white and light-blue background, allowing for high readability. (7) Back to the speaker, who is now gesturing more vigorously. He uses his hands to simulate collisions and movements. The visual focus is primarily on his head and shoulders, with the variety-style captions frequently updating at the bottom to reflect his spoken words. (8) A dramatic, glowing orange and red image of the Sun is shown, depicting intense solar activity and flares. This visual serves as a backdrop for the discussion on solar storms affecting satellite orbits. The image is high-contrast and fills the center of the frame. (9) In the final phase, the man summarizes his points, looking directly at the viewer. He makes a final comparison gesture, and the video concludes with the top-banner promotional text still visible.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 太空的衛星容量已經快滿了. [Logo]: 搜尋泛科學 Gemini 攻略免費看. [Slogan]: 太空的衛星容量已經快滿了. (2) [Subtitle]: 現在讓所有衛星操作員去放個假. (3) [Subtitle]: 那麼只要 67.2 個小時. (4) [Subtitle]: 也就是不到三天. (5) [Subtitle]: 我們的近地軌道就會發生災難性的連環車禍. (6) [Slogan]: 論文出處：arXiv (Thiele et al., 2025). (7) [Subtitle]: 如果你覺得臺灣的交通很. (8) [Subtitle]: 那我得告訴你天上的交通更是「絕命終結站」. (9) [Subtitle]: 最近發表在 arXiv 上的一篇論文. (10) [Subtitle]: 標題很嗆，叫做「軌道上的紙牌屋」. (11) [Subtitle]: 普林斯頓大學和英屬哥倫比亞大學的科學家. (12) [Subtitle]: 開發了一個全新的驚悚指數叫做「CRASH Clock」. (13) [Subtitle]: 全名是「碰撞實現與重大危害時鐘」. (14) [Subtitle]: 這時鐘不是拿來看幾點的，而是拿來看我們離死期還有多遠. (15) [Subtitle]: 這怎麼算的？科學家特別挑了兩個時間點來 PK. (16) [Subtitle]: 一個是「巨型星座時代」還沒降臨的 2018 年. (17) [Subtitle]: 那時候馬斯克還沒把天空當成水餃鍋在下. (18) [Subtitle]: 另一個是論文撰寫時的 2025 年 6 月.
